audience: A reader deciding from the headline image, or a shared link, whether to read on.
shows: The containment problem as a picture: an agent locked in a cell with your private files, passing a letter out through a slot in the wall to do its work. It proves nothing and shows no real system.
complements: The opening paragraphs say what the agent holds and what it is asked to do; the picture shows that doing that work means holes in the wall.
surrounding_text: Think of the medical result, the argument with your sister, the note from your lawyer. They read your email and answer it, book your travel, pay your bills.
alt: A flat illustration of a robot locked in a cell, at a desk stacked with private files. Its arm reaches through a slot in the wall, holding an envelope outside. It shows why an agent can't be sealed off and still be useful.
caption: To do anything for you, an agent has to reach outside. Every reach needs a gap in the wall.
